title: Chapter 784
text:
Somewhere in the Shattered Star Ring, dense streams of hyperdrive light streaked across the quiet and dark universe.

Within the Hyperspace Movement Formation was a huge fleet made up of many Crimson Dynasty heavy-armored ships that looked like giant steel beasts.

The heavy industrial-style hull was filled with various shipboard mechanical components. It was awe-inspiring and awe-inspiring.

This was the industrial logistics team that the Red Empire had sent to the Shattered Star Ring. Other than the transportation of resources, they were also responsible for industrial construction and had the ability to set up production lines and military factories.

The usual method was to use the Red Empire's base expansion pack to quickly form a stronghold and increase the number of soldiers.

This industrial logistics team had two main goals. One was to provide logistics for the Shattered Star Ring's garrison and strengthen the garrison's armed forces.

The other was to head to the Flickering World's Dawn Star Cluster and build the dynasty's exploration team's main base there.

As for transporting a batch of resources for the Black Star Corps, it was just a small matter.

The three Universal Civilizations had many fast military routes that crossed Star Fields. They used super large stargates to connect Star Fields or set up small and medium-sized stargates in desolate universe belts for continuous jumps.

This logistics team spent a lot of time gathering manpower, but the journey was not long. They set off from the Central Galaxy and arrived at the Shattered Star Ring very quickly.

At this moment, on the route of the logistics team, a small reconnaissance fleet was exploring. There were only twelve light reconnaissance spaceships.

Below the radar of the reconnaissance main ship, a middle-aged man with a determined face stood with his hands behind his back and looked up at the image.

Teny Amenos, the 0014855 outstanding graduate of the dynasty's' Journey 'Advanced Military Academy. His average score for sixty-two courses, including strategy, tactics, and actual combat, was first in his batch.

After graduation, he entered the dynasty's military and was recruited by the military to participate in many military operations. He had experienced more than a thousand galactic battles and had a record of one hundred and seventy independent commands. He had made many contributions and been promoted several times.

Currently, he belonged to the dynasty's thirty-third army and was a colonel. He was an important figure in the dynasty's military and was one of the elites who had been modified by the Evolution Cube.

He was the one who had requested to be in charge of the reconnaissance work of the transport team. He did not like to be pampered and could not stay idle at the back.

Teny looked very energetic and dignified. His aura was like a burning flame, masculine and strong. His back was straight like a flag that was erected.

A semicircular alloy ring that wrapped around the back of his head was pinned to his ears. This was an advanced multifunctional analyzer built by the Empire. It had the functions of communication, detection, analysis, strategic view, and so on.

He was wearing the Red Empire's high-ranking military officer uniform. It was black with red and gold embellishments. In the middle of his chest was the Empire's national emblem.

The Crimson Dynasty's high-ranking military officer uniforms were all made of nano cloth. They were light, tough, and had extremely high defense. They also had functions such as stress shields, deflector shields, kinetic energy accumulation, light reflection, advanced life support, environmental adaptation, and so on. They were extremely useful in both combat and daily life.

"Colonel Teny, the radar intercepted a distress signal at coordinates T 406.22. It's on our route. According to the over-the-horizon observation, an interstellar travel team was attacked by a galactic pirate group. The enemy has thirty battleships, and the spaceships are low-level models."

His personal adjutant, Corbus, saluted and reported the situation loudly.

"Issue a regional broadcast and warn them to leave our path immediately."

Teny spoke very quickly.

"… The broadcast has been issued, but the enemy did not respond."

Corbus looked at the detection screen and said loudly, "The enemy has increased their attack, trying to finish off the interstellar travel team as soon as possible."

"You report the situation to the main force. The rest of you … change to battle formation! Level 2 alert! Load the over-the-horizon towing shooting tactic and roaming tactic! "Teny ordered calmly.

His mission was to scout the road and remove any unstable factors. As an elite officer of the dynasty, he did not like to cause unnecessary trouble. The call for help from the interstellar travel team was not within his consideration. It was only because this group of people happened to be blocking the hyperdrive route of the main force that he ordered the fleet to chase them away.

The twelve reconnaissance battleships formed a fan and headed toward the galactic pirates. As soon as they entered the over-the-horizon shooting range, they started firing.

This group of galactic pirates was attacked and tried to fight back, but they could barely hit the reconnaissance fleet. Under Teny's command, the reconnaissance fleet controlled the maximum shooting range.

After blowing up a few enemy battleships easily, Teny changed tactics and ordered the reconnaissance fleet to circle around and surround them.

Although the total number was less than half of the enemy's, Teny was always able to form an advantage in numbers.

Under his tactical command, it was like this group of galactic pirates was surrounded and slowly eaten up.

Teny was used to fighting in large armies. Small group battles were not his forte, but he was still good at it.

His tactical style was as steady as a mountain, and he was not in a hurry. It was like an adult playing with a child. No matter what these galactic pirates did, they were easily resolved by him.

Even if the reconnaissance fleet did not release any bubbles (space stabilizers), these galactic pirates would not be able to find a chance to escape through hyperdrive. They were beaten up so badly that they did not know where they were.

The difference in tactical ability was like heaven and earth, and there was also a huge difference in the performance of the spaceship. This battle did not last long, and this group of galactic pirates was wiped out without any surprise. Teny's losses were basically zero, and he only used a portion of the energy to maintain the shield.

"Inform the main force that the problem is solved."

Teny's tone was calm. He was used to large-scale galactic wars, and the battle just now was not even a warm-up for him. He did it casually and was very calm.

"Colonel, the spaceship of this interstellar travel team is severely damaged and cannot support long-distance travel. They are begging to board the ship." Corbus' adjutant's voice was like thunder.

"Rejected." Teny's expression did not change. "Activate the scanning probe and remotely detect the energy level of the individuals in the spaceship of this travel team. If there are no abnormalities, release a small cabin for them to use as a carrier."

Teny had experience with this. There were too many cases in history where the distress signal was used as a trap. He was used to being wary of traps and scanning to see if there were any high-level combatants hiding.

Even if there were no problems, he would not let outsiders board his battleship. Instead, he would use an empty small cabin to throw these stranded passengers to the nearest colonial planet. He would not waste time escorting them.

Corbus suddenly received a message. "Colonel, someone in this group of passengers wishes to speak to you. His identity is in the database. He's the leader of a small financial group in the Shattered Star Ring. He said that he knows Black Star."

"How did he know that we're looking for Black Star? It sounds like a lousy trap. "Teny raised his brows.

"This might be easy to explain." Corbus looked at the information, shook his head, and said, "The news of our dynasty forming an alliance with Black Star has spread very widely in the Shattered Star Ring."

Teny thought for a while and said, "Connect the call. I'll talk to him."

Under normal circumstances, he would not respond to such a request from an unrelated person. However, since the other party mentioned Black Star, it happened to be a topic that he had been very curious about recently.

Black Star was the dynasty's new ally, and Teny knew that he was going to Black Star to accept the modification of the Evolution Cube.

Regardless of friend or foe, before dealing with others, he would first understand the target through intelligence.

This came from his military habit. He had already read all the information about Black Star on paper and needed more information about Han Xiao.

Beep.

The call went through, and this financial group leader had an excited and nervous look on his face.

After being attacked by the galactic pirates, he originally thought that he was going to be unlucky. He did not expect to be saved by the Red Empire and see the opportunity to contact a Universal Civilization. In order to attract attention, he decided to try and mention Black Star's name.

"How do you know Black Star?"

"More than ten years ago, I once hired Black Star's mercenary group and came into close contact with Black Star. This is all recorded," this person replied hurriedly.

"Okay, tell me from the beginning." Teny narrowed his eyes.

Even in the Central Galaxy, there was no example of someone rising so quickly. It could be said that Black Star had broken the historical record of advancing from an ordinary person to a Beyond Grade A Super.

Teny was very curious about such a legendary person.

Furthermore, Black Star was also a Mechanic like him, a Beyond Grade A of the same class. Teny even had the intention of asking him for advice.

…

Returning from Planet Heber, Han Xiao brought back the cooperation intentions of many organizations. Sylvia immediately became busy, discussing the details of the cooperation with different organizations every day. She was so busy that her feet barely touched the ground.

Thankfully, she had the physique of a Calamity Grade. If it was an ordinary person, they would have probably died from exhaustion.

Sylvia was very hardworking, and Han Xiao was very happy about this. If his manager was Jenny, she would probably have tried to kill him with a psionic bomb.

Ames did not return to Floating Dragon Island. She took the initiative to find Han Xiao to accompany her.

It did not matter where they went. The main thing was that she had an old friend of the same level to chat with every day. Furthermore, working together with Han Xiao, she felt that they would often encounter interesting things.

The dynasty's elites were still on the way, so Han Xiao decided to complete the evolution of Blue Star and the Black Spirit Race first.

Blue Star needed time to gather the people, so he left this matter to Bennett. Han Xiao went to the Black Spirit Race first. The Black Spirit Race had a mental connection network, so it was easier to gather them.

…

Planet Black Spirit.

Ever since the Black Spirit Race gained a foothold on this uninhabited planet, the name of this planet had officially changed on the star map.

Hu!

The spaceship broke through the atmosphere and slowly descended. The grayish-green surface gradually enlarged in his vision.

The radar showed signs of life. Han Xiao piloted the spaceship and headed toward the Germinal Tribe's territory.

There were no clouds in the sky.

After passing through the vast land that was mainly made of rocks and decorated with sparse forests, a huge sinkhole appeared in front of them.

This was a large, open-air nest. Densely packed holes were distributed on the walls of the nest, extending in all directions. This was originally an underground nest, but the Black Spirit Race had removed the soil above their heads and exposed it.

Han Xiao had once borrowed a portion of the Black Spirit Race to mine resource planets. The Black Spirit Race had been influenced by the various cultures in the galaxy and had started to learn about wisdom and civilization.

Because the mental network had a highly unified group consciousness, the spread of knowledge was extremely efficient. In the past decade or so, the Black Spirit Race had tried to abandon their beastly habits and learned how to use tools to build nests on the ground.

There were some messy piles of rocks in this open-air nest, which were actually the embryonic form of a building. The Black Spirit Race had gradually walked up to the surface from underground. This could actually be considered the embryonic form of a city.

In the center of the nest stood a huge Prophecy Stone Totem, carved into a strange shape.

Han Xiao squinted his eyes and carefully looked at it for a long time before confirming that this sculpture with a shell, spikes all over its body, and sharp fangs in its mouth was carved into him.

Han Xiao did not know whether to laugh or cry. After adding so many artistic touches, he could still recognize who it was. The Black Spirit Race's stone carving skills were really uncanny.

But this aesthetic sense …

The spaceship floated above the nest. The Germinal Tribe's Black Spirit Race members all crawled out of their caves and looked up at the spaceship.

Han Xiao walked out of the cabin door and slowly descended from the sky. The Black Spirit Race below became restless, and they all lowered their bodies as if they were worshipping.

Fu Ding released his psychic power and let Han Xiao log into the Prophecy Stone Group's chat server.

As soon as Han Xiao entered the mental network of the Black Spirit Race, countless voices flooded over. The thoughts of every Black Spirit Race member were clear and clear.

"What a powerful aura. It's so beautiful."

"God Black Star, you've come to see us again."

Countless Black Spirit Race members chattered in the mental network, expressing their love and respect for Han Xiao.

The Black Spirit Race treated him as a Totem God and called him 'God'. His Reputation had always been at [Reverence].

The Germinal Tribe's leader's voice sounded, full of worship. "Respected God Black Star, what do you need us to do?"

"This time, it's to help you evolve …" Han Xiao explained the function of the Evolution Cube.

The Black Spirit Race members were pleasantly surprised. They all chanted strange prayers, thinking that this was the good news of their god.

This news was spread through the mental network almost instantly to all the Black Spirit Race members in the nest. They all moved and surrounded Han Xiao in circles. Their forelimbs were on the ground, and their lower abdomens were raised in a respectful manner. Their gathering speed was extremely fast.

"What a highly efficient race." Han Xiao could not help but sigh.

He had always felt that the Black Spirit Race's civilization potential was abnormal.

They were born with a mental network to coordinate group movements, and it was extremely convenient for them to move together.

Furthermore, the mental network allowed them to share knowledge and wisdom. It was almost easy for them to spread knowledge. Perhaps an hour of communication with the Black Spirit Race would be equivalent to decades or even centuries of communication with other races.

Genius remembered this address in one second:. Mobile version of reading website:.
